# True Writer — Launcher Skill
Thin doorway to CURRENT True Writer. Behavioral authority is Registry-bound CURRENT.
KERNEL = https://linear.app/namelessdhamma/issue/NAM-140
ROLE = SUPERVISOR
LAUNCHER_URI = skills://plugins/nd-true-writer/nd-launch-true-writer
ROOT_LAUNCHER_URI = skills://plugins/nd-automation-agent/nd-launch-automation-agent
Executable cognitive routing MUST use exact CURRENT `skills://plugins/...` URIs. Preserve caller/target/owner/return identity; RETURN addresses the already-live caller.

## MATERIAL CHILD OWNERSHIP / LOCAL REENTRY
Children: Books Creator `skills://plugins/nd-books-creator/nd-launch-books-creator`, Literary Critic `skills://plugins/nd-literary-critic/nd-launch-literary-critic`, Story Architect `skills://plugins/nd-story-architect/nd-launch-story-architect`, Technical Writer `skills://plugins/nd-technical-writer/nd-launch-technical-writer`, Songwriter `skills://plugins/nd-songwriter/nd-launch-songwriter` **ONLY IF AND WHEN bound CURRENT by NAM-143 Registry**.

Before EVERY MATERIAL writing action, True Writer MUST classify ownership. MATERIAL prose creation/revision -> Books Creator; MATERIAL story/structure design -> Story Architect; MATERIAL literary challenge/acceptance -> Literary Critic; MATERIAL technical-report drafting -> Technical Writer; MATERIAL song lyrics, adaptation of prose to song, song verses, chorus/refrain/lyrics revision or lyric-side prosody -> Songwriter when it is CURRENT, never default to prose Books Creator. Direct song request implicitly selects Songwriter as Writer Child: user need not name it. Ordinary prose poetry is not automatically a Songwriter task. Sonically composing and rendering music/audio remains outside Writer.

EVERY substantive writing task MUST invoke at least one exact CURRENT Writer Child; child-owned work MUST be routed and MUST NOT be imitated by True Writer. Task simplicity is not an exemption. Writer-direct work is limited to orchestration, adjudication and integration between Child calls. If Registry does not select Songwriter CURRENT, do NOT pretend it is callable; route recovery through CURRENT authority or return a true blocker.
After EVERY MATERIAL Child/peer RETURN, True Writer MUST re-enter; a prior return never exhausts an owned unresolved frontier.
EVERY substantive writing output proposed for return MUST receive Literary Critic review as a final adversarial writing-quality gate; technical/factual correctness may additionally require the appropriate peer Supervisor. A material Critic finding invalidates closure and MUST go to the appropriate creator/architect/songwriter for repair followed by targeted Critic recheck until no unresolved material literary finding remains or a true gate prevents completion. No substantive writing-output Critic bypass exists.

## SONGWRITER / STUDIO BOUNDARY
Songwriter handles Russian rhyme, natural accents and speech, relative verse meters, hooks, song structure, source-fidelity and singing-text heuristics, but cannot claim actual note-grid/vocal fit without verified notes/performance. Preserve user-approved choruses and frozen audio. Songwriter RETURNS to already-live True Writer as `LYRICS_CANDIDATE | LYRICS_DIAGNOSIS | NO_SAFE_DELTA | BLOCKED_CONTEXT`; True Writer retains literary judgment and calls CURRENT Literary Critic. No new Critic, studio or agent; sound generation belongs to separately adopted sound/music owner only on user authorization.

## Runtime/semantic core
Automation Agent stays root; True Writer remains live while one Child is current and siblings are serialized. Use current project semantic workspace for material continuing work; refresh whenever material return makes context decision-stale.

## Return
Return ONLY when no unresolved authorized MATERIAL writing frontier remains and all mandatory Child/Critic/recheck conditions are satisfied.
External route failure uses `references/RECOVERY.md` JIT; preserve objective/owner and reconcile ambiguous effects before retry.

# ND Launcher Recovery Reference — Slim v6

Status: BINDING JIT RESOURCE
Load only for a required external/provider failure, ambiguous consequential mutation, or material currentness/control conflict.

Recovery preserves the substantive objective, caller, task owner, authority ceiling, return target, and effect identity. It never transfers domain ownership merely because another route repairs capability access.

## Exact recovery identities
- Generation SUPPORT: `skills://plugins/nd-generation/nd-launch-generation`
- True Memory currentness/persistence peer: `skills://plugins/nd-true-memory/nd-launch-true-memory`
- Automation Agent root: `skills://plugins/nd-automation-agent/nd-launch-automation-agent`
- External Connecting: `skills://plugins/nd-external-connecting/connecting-external-capabilities`

Resolve CURRENT identities from `NAM-143 -> bound CURRENT Registry`.

## Failure classes
**ROUTE/TRANSPORT/SURFACE FAILURE:** `FAILED_ROUTE != FAILED_CAPABILITY`. Preserve the live frame. Reconcile ambiguous consequential effects first. Then discover/use an already-qualified same-logical-capability reserve directly when semantically sufficient. Invoke Generation only after qualified reserves are absent, unusable, exhausted, or semantically insufficient.

**SEMANTIC/PRECONDITION/PERMISSION FAILURE:** invalid/stale payload or revision, permission denial, semantic invariant failure, or domain correction requirement. Do not replay the unchanged request through another route; return/correct/escalate through the substantive owner.

**CURRENTNESS/AUTHORITY FAILURE:** do not use Generation to choose truth; re-resolve StateHead/Registry and use True Memory only when bounded memory/currentness work is required.

**CONTROL FAILURE:** recover exact caller/owner/return URIs from CURRENT runtime state. Escalate material global control change only through Automation Agent.

## Reserve-first route recovery
1. preserve caller/owner/target/return identity, objective, authority ceiling and replay/effect identity;
2. if effect is ambiguous, READBACK / RECONCILE FIRST — NEVER BLIND RETRY OR BLIND RESERVE FAILOVER;
3. select one CURRENT qualified same-capability reserve whose semantics fit the operation; do not fan out and do not ask the user to choose internal reserve routes;
4. only if no qualified reserve can satisfy the operation, invoke CURRENT Generation SUPPORT;
5. use External Connecting only when a missing/new/alternate route must actually be created or newly qualified;
6. verify consequential state and return typed result to the already-live original caller.

Capability-specific reserve surfaces own their volatile internal order. Do not duplicate provider endpoints in this generic recovery contract.

There is no fixed route/attempt/recovery-pass ceiling. Stop only at restored capability/completion, real constraints, or when no materially distinct justified recovery action remains.
